script_text: Stop! Taurus, this cosmic pressure is not random. Saturn in Taurus is opposing the Sun in Virgo, a hard 180-degree alignment that activates your 10th House of career, reputation, and public direction. The Sun also squares Uranus in Taurus, stirring sudden changes in your 1st House of identity and initiative. As an Earth sign ruled by Venus, you need steady choices, not impulsive reactions. In romance, Venus asks you to name what you value; a partner may seek clarity, while singles attract someone practical through one-on-one conversation in the 7th House. At work, the Saturn-Sun opposition favors disciplined presentation, but avoid signing anything before checking the numbers; a financial opportunity may arrive through your 2nd House of income. Blessing or warning: unexpected support can come from an older colleague, yet arrogance or rushed spending could cost you. Follow for tomorrow's reading and let Venus guide your next move.
